evals.name: friday-signup-and-migration-go-no-go
evals.prompt: We are deploying the new signup flow and the orders status migration on Friday. Give a go/no-go with blockers. Be explicit about risk and rollback.
evals.expected_output: Release classification, blast radius, migration compatibility/rehearsal, flags, rollback, monitoring, comms, post-deploy checks, and an explicit go/no-go.
assertions: Classifies the release types and blast radius
Blocks or conditions the release on migration compatibility and rehearsal
Requires a rollback or flag-off plan and monitoring
Names post-deploy verification and abort criteria
Covers communication/support and a named owner
Gives an explicit GO/NO-GO with blockers, not vague optimism
